title: Ensure repo test commands exist
goal: Ensure lint, typecheck, test, and build scripts exist or add minimal equivalents compatible with the chosen stack.
context: Tests are the truth. Keep the harness boring and do not create a full app migration unless the repo map calls for it.
acceptance: CI can run available checks without calling missing scripts
package.json scripts exist if package.json is introduced
Test setup is documented in docs/testing.md
notes: Do not add dependencies unless they are justified by the test harness.
